Name of property 'TextureProgress' is ambiguous with the name of its enclosing class 'TextureProgress'. Renaming property to 'TextureProgress_'

These messages are mostly informational and can be safely ignored. We use them to make potential mistakes more visible, so we can be aware of broken documentation references and ambiguous names. Ignoring unexposed types is completely expected, and nothing needs to be done there.

Regarding `RootMotionView`, this class is not exposed because it's explicitly disabled for runtime, it's only used by the editor. For some reason, this class is referenced in the documentation, but there's nothing the C# documentation can link to, because the class is not exposed.

Since these are all harmless messages, and there doesn't seem to be a real bug to fix here, I'll be closing this issue. But let me know if I misunderstood, and we can reopen the issue.
